claim_checks.claim: The only AAA Five Diamond hotel within Walt Disney World Resort
claim_checks.note: Visit Orlando calls it Central Florida's first and only AAA Five Diamond resort; it first received the award in 2014. Since then the Ritz-Carlton Orlando, Grande Lakes (outside Walt Disney World) has also earned Five Diamonds, so 'within Walt Disney World' is the accurate framing. 2026 status not re-verified.

claim_checks.claim: Sole luxury hotel inside Disney World's gates
claim_checks.note: Disney's own deluxe resorts (for example the Grand Floridian Resort & Spa) are also inside Walt Disney World. Four Seasons is in the gated Golden Oak community on Disney property.
There is no walk-in or direct access. Guests ride a complimentary motor coach to the parks; for Magic Kingdom they are dropped at the Ticket & Transportation Center and continue by monorail.

claim_checks.claim: Rooftop dining at Capa with fireworks views
claim_checks.note: Capa is on the 17th floor with a terrace overlooking the Walt Disney World fireworks.
Tranquilo Golf Course: Tom Fazio design, par 71, 6,968 yards, certified Audubon sanctuary.

claim_checks.claim: The only spa within Disney property
claim_checks.note: Senses, A Disney Spa operates at Disney's Grand Floridian and Disney's Saratoga Springs.

claim_checks.claim: Explorer Island water park with lazy river is exclusive to guests
claim_checks.note: Five-acre Explorer Island has a lazy river with rapids and two water slides. Pools, Explorer Island and the kids' club are reserved for registered resort guests.

claim_checks.claim: Many rooms offer unobstructed Magic Kingdom fireworks views from private balconies
claim_checks.note: Some rooms and suites have park and fireworks views, but 'many' and 'unobstructed' are not supported. The fireworks are seen at a distance.

claim_checks.claim: Book a Magic Kingdom-facing room on floors 10-17
claim_checks.note: The building has 17 storeys and Capa occupies the 17th floor, so 'floors 10-17' for rooms is doubtful. No source specifies floors.
Contemporary Spanish steakhouse. Note: it held a Michelin star 2022-2025, lost it in the 2026 Florida guide, and is now Michelin Recommended.

claim_checks.claim: Complimentary Kids for All Seasons program with supervised activities
claim_checks.note: Complimentary, daily, ages 4-12, at The Mansion on Explorer Island.
Good Morning Breakfast with Goofy & Pals at Ravello, historically Saturdays only. Check the current schedule.

claim_checks.claim: Sunset cocktails at Capa bar during fireworks
claim_checks.note: Fireworks are viewed from Capa's rooftop terrace, but the fireworks are a nighttime show, so 'sunset during fireworks' is misleading.

claim_checks.claim: Exclusive early park access before general admission
claim_checks.note: Early Theme Park Entry 30 minutes early daily at any Disney theme park. This is shared with Disney resort hotels, not exclusive to Four Seasons.

claim_checks.claim: Prime Disney World location with exclusive park access
claim_checks.note: The location on Disney property is confirmed. Park access is by shuttle, and the early entry is shared with other Disney resort hotels, so 'exclusive park access' is wrong.

claim_checks.claim: Family-friendly resort with dedicated kids' club
claim_checks.note: Kids for All Seasons at The Mansion.
Five pools, including Oasis (adults 21+) and the family pool, plus 2 tennis and 4 pickleball courts and golf.

facts.text: Opened August 2014: 443 keys (375 rooms and 68 suites) in a 17-storey building on 26.5 acres.
facts.source_title: Four Seasons Press Room - Orlando fact sheet

facts.text: Located in the Golden Oak community on Walt Disney World property, at 10100 Dream Tree Blvd., Lake Buena Vista, minutes from the four Disney theme parks.
facts.source_title: Four Seasons Press Room - Orlando fact sheet

facts.text: Guests get Early Theme Park Entry (30 minutes early daily) and complimentary luxury motor coach transportation to the Disney parks.
facts.source_title: Four Seasons Press Room - Spring 2026 programming

facts.text: AAA Five Diamond since 2014 (Central Florida's first) and Forbes Five-Star.
facts.source_title: Visit Orlando - Four Seasons Resort Orlando

facts.text: Capa, the 17th-floor Spanish steakhouse with a fireworks-view terrace, held a Michelin star 2022-2025 and is Michelin Recommended in the 2026 Florida guide.
facts.source_title: List of Michelin-starred restaurants in Florida - Wikipedia

facts.text: Other dining: Ravello (modern Italian, Saturday Goofy & Pals character breakfast), PB&G (Southern and Florida), Plancha (Cuban American) and the Lobby Bar.
facts.source_title: Four Seasons Press Room - Orlando fact sheet

facts.text: Explorer Island is a heated five-acre water park with a lazy river with rapids and two water slides, reserved for resort guests.
facts.source_title: Four Seasons Press Room - Spring 2026 programming

facts.text: Oasis is an infinity-edge lakeside pool for guests 21 and over; the resort has five pools in total.
facts.source_title: Four Seasons Press Room - Spring 2026 programming

facts.text: Kids For All Seasons is a complimentary daily camp for ages 4-12 at The Mansion on Explorer Island, 9am-5pm.
The spa has 18 treatment rooms, including 4 couples' suites, and is rated Forbes Five-Star.
facts.source_title: Four Seasons Press Room - Orlando fact sheet

facts.text: Tranquilo Golf Course is a Tom Fazio design (par 71, 6,968 yards) and a certified Audubon sanctuary.
facts.source_title: Four Seasons Press Room - Orlando fact sheet

considerations.text: Parks are not walkable. Guests rely on the hotel's motor coach (or a car), and Magic Kingdom trips go via the Ticket & Transportation Center and then the monorail.
considerations.source_title: Magic Guides - Orlando hotels with Disney shuttle service

considerations.text: Capa lost its Michelin star in the 2026 Florida guide (now Recommended). Older copy calling it Michelin-starred is out of date.
The Oasis pool is adults 21+ only. Families use Explorer Island and the family pool.
considerations.source_title: Four Seasons Press Room - Spring 2026 programming

considerations.text: Fireworks are seen at a distance. Capa's rooftop terrace is the reliable viewing spot, while park-view rooms vary.
considerations.source_title: Four Seasons Press Room - Spring 2026 programming

considerations.text: The kids' club is for ages 4-12 only; younger children need parental supervision or babysitting.

best_for: Families doing Disney in luxury: complimentary kids' club for ages 4-12, guest-only Explorer Island water park, early park entry and park shuttles.
Multi-generational groups: 68 suites, golf at Tranquilo and a Forbes Five-Star spa for non-park days.
Couples on an adults' Orlando trip: the 21+ Oasis pool and fireworks from Capa's rooftop terrace.
Golfers: on-site Tom Fazio-designed Tranquilo course.
